name: Infantry_Ticker
author: Infantry AI
description: The card:ticker chat card: a value that changes over time (a price, a metric, a count) drawn as the latest value, its change and a sparkline. A sample of an addressable card: an agent posts it with an id, then appends values with op=append and the first card shows them all. Any agent may use it while this plugin is loaded; without it a card:ticker block shows as code.

cards.summary: A value over time (price, metric, count): latest value, change and a sparkline; append new values to the same card
cards.spec:
Ticker card (Infantry_Ticker): a value that changes over time.

Post it once with an id, in its own fenced block, info string `card:ticker id=<name>`, body ONE JSON object:

```card:ticker id=acme
{"title": "ACME", "unit": "USD", "items": [{"label": "09:30", "value": 101.2}]}
```

Then, in later replies of the SAME session, add values with `op=append` (only the new items):

```card:ticker id=acme op=append
{"items": [{"label": "09:35", "value": 102.8}]}
```

The first card redraws with every value; each update shows as a small muted line. `op=replace` replaces the whole body. Fields: `title` (required), `unit` (optional, shown after the value), `items[]` with `value` (number, required) and `label` (optional, e.g. a time). Never invent values: use only numbers you fetched or measured. Keep one plain sentence outside the block.
